How to protect swag canvas,

Today we are going to show you how to protect the canvas on your swag so it stays in good condition for lots of camping trips to come,

Bowdens own Fabratection and Square bear is very easy to use and will take less than a weekend to have your swag fully protected for the next camping trip.
